name: Tianhe
about: Tianhe (2021-035A), a station core, launched 2021 Apr 29. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (O).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2021 Apr 29), held fixed
